description: Download a named app's persistent /data volume as a gzipped tar file (L13 — the BACKUP primitive: your human's data is never locked in). Owner-only (account key). Writes the archive to a local path and returns its location + size.

app.description: The named app whose /data to back up

dest.description: Local file path for the backup (default: <app>-data.tgz)

name: openpouch_data_pull
